title: BA-LoRA: BIAS-ALLEVIATING LOW-RANK ADAPTATION TO MITIGATE CATASTROPHIC INHERITANCE IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating feature manifold degradation by fine-tuning models on an artificially imbalanced version of the MNLI dataset (skewed to a 100:10:1 class ratio) and visualizing the resulting hidden-layer feature representations using t-SNE to check for class overlap.

Comparing downstream fine-tuning performance on the GLUE benchmark between models pre-trained on high-quality, curated corpora (RoBERTa) versus those pre-trained on noisier, web-scale corpora (T5) to measure vulnerability to inherited noise.
